suspended: {name} is off the app. Customers can't book, and the day can only be viewed. Write to us to sort it out.
suspendedReason: {name} is off the app: {reason}. Customers can't book, and the day can only be viewed. Write to us to sort it out.
notOnBoard: That booking isn't on this day's board any more. It may have been moved or cancelled.
refreshFailed: Couldn't refresh: {message} Showing what we had.
noBarbersOwner: Add your barbers and their hours to start taking bookings.
noBarbersOther: The owner hasn’t added barbers yet.
setupIntro: Customers can book once the needed steps are done.
setupIntroWaiting: Do these while you wait for our visit: once {name} is approved, customers can book straight away.
setupIntroHelper: What's left before customers can book. The owner does most of it.
setupBarberHours: Give each barber his services and weekly hours
setupBarberHoursNamed: Give {name} his services and weekly hours
setupNotifications: Get a notification on this phone for every booking
setupTeam: Give your barbers and helper their own sign-in
setupTeamBody: A barber's sign-in is on his page under Barbers. A helper is added in Team.
setupShare: Share your salon with your customers
setupOwnerOnly: Only the owner can do this. Ask them to open Today on their phone.
setupLaterWaiting: After approval: share your salon and make your first offer.
setupReady: Your salon is ready. Customers can book now.
setupReadyWaiting: All set. Customers can book as soon as {name} is approved.
doneFinished: Done. The rest of the time is free.
doneCancelledBooking: Cancelled. The customer has been told.
timeHasStarted: Its time has started. Press Start when the customer is here.
sheetGone: This isn't on this day's board any more: the customer may have moved it, or it went to another barber.
inChairTooLong: In the chair for over {minutes} minutes: use Done early instead of cancelling.
startCodeHint: It is on the customer's booking screen. The code shows they are here.
startClosedOpensAt: Start is closed now: it opens at {time}.
startClosedHoldOver: Start is closed now: the hold until {time} is over.
startAnyway: Customer can't show the code: start anyway
confirmFinish: The customer is done: the rest of this time becomes free for others. This can't be undone.
confirmNoShowBooking: The customer didn’t come. Their time is freed and they get a missed-booking strike.
confirmNoShowWalkIn: The walk-in left. Their time is freed.
reassignInChair: The rest of the visit moves to him from now. He must do these services and be free now.
reassignBooked: Same time, another barber. He must do these services and be free then.
confirmRemoveBlock: This time becomes free for bookings again.
statusChanged: Someone changed it meanwhile: it is now "{status}".
walkInNameTooShort: Write at least 2 letters of the name, or leave it empty.
walkInPriceChanged: The price changed just now (an offer started or ended): it's {price} now. Check it with the customer, then tap Start again.
walkInSuspended: The salon is off the app.
walkInAboutOfferTill: About {duration} · the salon's offer price till {time}
walkInAboutOfferToday: About {duration} · the salon's offer price today
walkInTickHint: Tick what they want: the total shows here.
walkInOfferUnchecked: Couldn't check the salon's offer, so these are the usual prices.
walkInNoServicesBody: The owner adds services under Salon.
walkInNotAllowedBody: Ask the owner to turn on walk-ins for you in Team.
walkInMaxServices: At most {max} services in one walk-in: untick one to choose another.
walkInNoBarberTogether: No barber does all of these together. Add them as separate walk-ins.
walkInNoBarber: No barber does all of these services.
walkInHeld: We couldn't tell if it was added. Try again: it won't be added twice.
walkInCheckTotal: Check the total below, then tap Start.
closeExplain: The whole salon is closed: every barber, including ones you add later. Anything already booked must be moved or cancelled first.
listRefreshFailed: Couldn't refresh the list. It may be a little out of date.
noUpcomingBody: New online bookings show here and on the day board.
upcomingCapped: Showing the next {count} bookings. Open a day on Today to see the ones after.
historyRange: Pick up to 31 days, ending today or earlier.
historyCapped: Showing the latest {count}. Pick fewer days to see the earlier ones.
pickStartEnd: Pick a start and an end time.
endAfterStart: The end must be after the start.
ownBreakDays: Your own breaks can be for today or tomorrow. Ask the owner for time off further ahead.
ownBreakHours: Your own breaks can be at most 4 hours a day. Ask the owner for longer.
pickFirstLast: Pick the first and last day.
lastAfterFirst: The last day must be on or after the first day.
leaveTooLong: Leave can be at most {days} days at a time.
openFromColumn: Open this from your column on Today.
cantBookName: Customers can't book {name} in this time. India time.
cantBookBarber: Customers can't book the barber in this time. India time.
ownBreaksNote: Your own breaks: today or tomorrow, up to 4 hours a day. The owner gives longer time off.
somethingBooked: Something is already booked in this time
moveThenSave: Give these to another barber or cancel them on the day board, then save again.
pauseExplain: Customers can't book until then. Bookings already made and walk-ins carry on.
setupBarberOne: Give a barber his services and weekly hours
refusedOwner: Only the owner can open that screen. Ask {ownerName}.
refusedOwnerHelper: Only the owner or a helper can open that screen. Ask {ownerName}.
walkInNoServicesBodyOwner: Add your services first, then you can add a walk-in.
startCodeAskOwner: Customer can't show the code? Ask the owner or the helper to start it.
